subject: Logistics: Client Executive Offsite — Visitor Pre-Screen & Escort Matrix
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
To: Diane Hart <diane.hart@bluewave.com>, Tom Li <tom.li@bluewave.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: Natalie Park <natalie.park@venuecorp.com>
Date: Thu, 09 Jul 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Logistics: Client Executive Offsite — Visitor Pre-Screen & Escort Matrix

Hi all,

Thanks again for confirming BlueWave's executive offsite on July 22–23 at Redwood HQ. To reduce friction at the front desk and keep security clearance moving, please see the items we need to finalize this week:  

1) Visitor pre-screen form: please complete the attached visitor_screener_form.pdf for each external attendee. We need full legal name, org, DOB (for badge check), company email, and emergency contact.
2) Cleared list: Diane, can you send a CSV of attendees who require no special vetting by EOD Friday? If anyone needs a KBA or additional clearance, flag them.
3) Escort matrix: see escort_matrix_template.xlsx attached. We propose 1:6 escort ratio for executive attendees in secure areas; adjust as needed.
4) Arrival windows and badge pickup: badges will be available at Security Desk A starting 07:00 on 7/22. External attendees must present government ID for temporary badge issuance.
5) Device policy: no personal recording devices allowed in the secure demo lab. Phones permitted in common areas but not inside demo rooms.
6) Parking & dropoff: Natalie — can you confirm reserved visitor parking locations and temporary permits?
7) Security brief: Sean, can you provide a 5-minute security orientation we can send pre-arrival (recommended).

Action items:  
- Diane: cleared attendee CSV + any redlines to the device policy (due 2026-07-09, 17:00 PT)
- BlueWave execs: complete visitor_screener_form.pdf (due 2026-07-15)
- Natalie: confirm parking & check-in flow (due 2026-07-12)
- Sean: security orientation draft (due 2026-07-12)

Attached: visitor_screener_form.pdf, escort_matrix_template.xlsx, venue_map.pdf

Thanks — want to get this locked down today to avoid last-minute issues.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Program Manager, Customer Events
Redwood Inference

---
(Attachment stubs: visitor_screener_form.pdf (form, 2 pages), escort_matrix_template.xlsx (spreadsheet), venue_map.pdf (1 page map))

On Thu, Jul 9, 2026 at 9:14 AM Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks again for confirming BlueWave's executive offsite...

Quick notes from security:  

- Background checks: for execs who will access the secure demo lab (where we host customer-only models/data), we can accept the BlueWave cleared list but need to run a quick identity verification against government ID at badge pickup. If anyone is flagged for a deeper check, we'll need a minimum of 48 hours.
- Temporary credentials: we'll create time-bound visitor credentials that expire at 18:00 on 7/23. Do not use for remote VPN access.
- Escorting: agree with 1:6 for general tours; inside the demo lab we require 1:3 for any guest that will see live customer data or model outputs tied to sensitive verticals.
- Photo badges: we will take a live photo at check-in. If BlueWave prefers to pre-upload badge photos, provide the files in the CSV and mark the column 'photo_uploaded'.
- Equipment policy: personal recording devices are prohibited inside lab rooms. For press or partner media, security will issue laminated non-electronic badges on request and will supervise.
- Audit trail: sign-in logs and temporary credential issuance will be retained for 90 days; if BlueWave requires a different retention window for compliance reasons, let us know ASAP.

I'll draft a short 5-minute security brief and attach to the pre-arrival packet (door card and calendar invite). Also recommend we include a one-paragraph data handling callout for the executive agenda so hosts are reminded.

Sean Gallagher
Head of Physical Security Operations
Redwood Inference

(Attachment: security-brief-draft.txt — stubbed, one-paragraph callout)

- We have one external advisor (contractor) — Julian Morales — whose COI paperwork is pending. We'll upload his photo separately.

We accept the device policy as written but request that our legal rep be present for a 2-minute handshake on intellectual property protocols before the lab tour.

Tom and I will complete the visitor_screener_form and send any missing DOBs by Monday.

Best,
Diane Hart

BlueWave Systems

All — logistics confirmation:  

- Parking: Natalie confirmed reserved spots P2-P4 (3 spaces) plus overflow lot L6 with shuttle. I will provide permit stickers at check-in.
- Badge pickup flow: External guests proceed to Security Desk A, sign the paper log, have photo taken, and receive a laminated visitor badge. Security will hold a stack of laminated non-electronic badges for media.
- Catering & timing: breakfast served 07:30–09:00 in Conference Hall B; lunch 12:00–13:00. Please advise dietary restrictions by 2026-07-15.
- Meeting rooms: we have Main Theater (7/22 AM), Breakout Room C (7/22 PM), and Demo Lab (7/23 AM). Demo Lab has additional PPE and an NLR sign-on.
- Emergency contact: security dispatch line (x7400) will be monitored throughout the event.

I'll update the shared drive (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-offsite-logistics) with arrival manifests and a final floor plan by Monday EOD.

Laura Bennett
